title: The solar system
explanation: Sun + eight planets, Earth's Moon, Saturn's rings, the asteroid belt and a simplified Kuiper belt with Pluto. Click a label to inspect. Sizes and distances are illustrative; bodies are static, not at today's positions.

objects.label: Sun
objects.description: The star at the center of the solar system. Planet sizes are enlarged and orbital distances compressed to make this scene readable.

objects.label: Mercury
objects.description: The innermost planet: a small rocky world with a heavily cratered surface.

objects.label: Venus
objects.description: A rocky planet wrapped in thick clouds and a dense atmosphere.

objects.label: Earth
objects.description: Our home planet, with liquid-water oceans. The nearby small construct represents the Moon.

objects.label: Mars
objects.description: The fourth planet: a cold, rocky world with a reddish surface.

objects.label: Jupiter
objects.description: The largest planet, a gas giant. Its moons and atmospheric bands are omitted from this overview.

objects.label: Saturn
objects.description: A gas giant surrounded by rings made of ice and rocky material. The ring tilt is illustrative.

objects.label: Uranus
objects.description: An ice giant with an unusually tilted rotation axis. Its faint rings and moons are omitted.

objects.label: Neptune
objects.description: The outermost of the eight planets: a blue ice giant.

objects.label: Illustrative orbit paths
objects.description: Eight circular paths show the order of the planets. Real orbits are elliptical; sizes, spacing, and current positions are not represented accurately.

objects.label: Moon
objects.description: Earth's natural satellite. Its distance and size are exaggerated for visibility.

objects.label: Saturn's rings
objects.description: A simplified ring disk around Saturn. Individual ring gaps are not modeled.

objects.label: Asteroid belt
objects.description: A broad population of rocky objects between Mars and Jupiter. The dust-like visualization is schematic, not an actual asteroid map.

objects.label: Kuiper belt
objects.description: A simplified region of icy bodies beyond Neptune, including dwarf planets such as Pluto. The more distant scattered disk and Oort cloud are outside this view.

objects.label: Pluto (dwarf planet)
objects.description: A dwarf planet in the outer solar system, shown as a representative Kuiper belt object. It is not one of the eight planets.
